title: Fold Points and Spatial Remnants
text: Craft nine Excited Rough Spatial Crystal Blocks into one Spatial Fold Point at a crafting table.
Harvest a point with a Dissociation spell or a ritual sword's melee, charged slash or flying needle. It leaves an unbreakable Spatial Remnant. The harvested point item cannot be placed directly.

Like Time Warp Points, a stack of 16 Spatial Fold Points collapses into one Unstable Spacetime Aggregate in non-hotbar inventory slots or ordinary storage. Spacetime Stabilization protects stacks inside crystal orbs.
Move remnants with a Pocket Magic Bottle, or condense eight fold points into one placeable remnant at an Advanced Condensation Table for 300 mana.

Spatial disturbance drives regeneration: moving entities accumulate disturbances that allow a fold point to form again. A Spatial Remnant pools movement from all entities within its five-block spherical range, including players, creatures and dropped items. After a combined 100 blocks of movement, it regenerates into a Spatial Fold Point in place. Standing still contributes nothing; earned distance survives leaving the area, reloading and transport by bottle.
Folding checks a safe landing for the entire vehicle and passenger group and grants a brief arrival cooldown. Leaving the sphere interrupts charging.
Reverse Time Flow and Spatial Blade also harvest both Time Warp Points and Spatial Fold Points on contact, without requiring Construction or any other spell element.
